title: SIMAI Framework unit passport
description: The identity card of one unit a source publishes (standard simai.linkage): a stable id, a version, its owner, the files that make it, one content hash over them and the units it depends on. A class component, a utility folder or a plugin keeps it as passport.json in its folder; a unit whose files do not sit in one folder of its own (a token set, a font, an icon set, a shared module, the core) keeps it under src/core/passports/<id>.json and names its files through includes. A Smart component and a host port are not given a file: their passports are derived from component.json and from the port's edition folders. scripts/linkage.mjs writes files, content_sha256 and dependencies; a person writes the version.

id.description: <kind>.<name>, never reused or silently renamed (simai.linkage id-never-changes).

kind.description: The part of the id before the first dot.

version.description: major.minor.patch with the meaning of simai.linkage semver-meaning; it moves whenever content_sha256 moves against the previous release.

owner.description: The repository that owns the unit, e.g. simai/ui-source.

includes.description: What the unit claims: a path ending in / claims every committed file under it, any other path claims that file. A file belongs to the unit whose claim is the longest; two equal claims are a defect. A passport.json in a folder claims its folder implicitly and omits this.

files.description: Every file of the unit, repository-relative, in ascending byte order. Passport files are never part of a unit.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the files in the order listed: for each file its path (UTF-8), a zero byte, its length in bytes as decimal digits, a zero byte, then its bytes. Computed from the committed tree, not the working tree.

range.description: The versions accepted: a caret range, ^major.minor.patch (same major and not lower; for 0.x the same minor).

manual.description: Declared by a person, not found in the code; scripts/linkage.mjs --write keeps it.

dependencies.description: The units this one uses, each with the range it accepts: the units its rule names as relations, the files its stylesheets and scripts import or load by url(), and the foundations whose custom properties it reads. A dependency found in the code but missing here fails the check; one a person adds by hand is marked manual and kept.

journal.description: The change journal record of the rename (contracts/changes/journal.json).

former_ids.description: Earlier ids of this unit (simai.linkage id-never-changes).
